objective: Make source-backed scientific validation execution fail closed so acquisition failures cannot be silently converted into a successful workflow.

baseline.description: Scientific validation acquisition and derivation steps still used continue-on-error and the scheduled gate accepted exit code 2.

correctness.reason: CI execution is required to establish the post-change measurement.

reliability.reason: CI execution is required to establish the post-change measurement.

reproducibility.reason: CI execution is required to establish the post-change measurement.

measurement.trade_off: The workflow may now fail when external scientific evidence is unavailable; evidence artifacts remain retained for diagnosis.

evidence: Workflow changes remove silent continuation from source acquisition and 730k derivation.
The gate is evaluated even after upstream acquisition failure so release evidence is retained.
validation.blocker: Post-change CI and external scientific acquisition still require execution before this lifecycle stage can be marked fully verified.

root_causes: Source acquisition and derivation failures were previously allowed to continue.
The scheduled workflow previously accepted scientific gate exit code 2.

findings: Fail-closed scientific validation must propagate acquisition and derivation failures to workflow status.
Diagnostic evidence should still be uploaded after a blocking failure.

open_blockers: Real source-backed scientific evidence acquisition remains external and release-blocking.
